map.输入同一操作者多次重复测量同一零件所得读数，按极差法用平均极差 R̄ 除以 d₂: Enter the readings from one operator repeatedly measuring the same part, and use the range method to divide the average range Rbar by the d2 coefficient to get the repeatability standard deviation sigma_r. Used in measurement system analysis (MSA) to quantify the random fluctuation of the gauge itself.
map.重复性标准偏差 = 平均极差 / d₂。: Repeatability standard deviation = average range / d2.
map.算同一人重复测量变异: Compute variation in repeated measurements by the same person
map.：重复性 EV = Rbar * K1（极差法）。例：Rbar=0.003、K1: : Repeatability EV = Rbar * K1 (range method). Example: Rbar = 0.003, K1 = 0.5908 (2 trials), EV = 0.0018.
map.：查 d₂=2.059，σ_r=0.07/2.059=0.0340；99% 过程: : Looking up d2 = 2.059, sigma_r = 0.07/2.059 = 0.0340; the 99% process spread is 5.15*sigma_r = 0.1751. d2 changes with the number of repeats, and choosing the wrong one noticeably affects the result.
map.由测量系统误差与公差求 %GRR: %GRR from measurement system error and tolerance
map.由扩展不确定度求单侧 95% 保护带: One-sided 95% guard band from expanded uncertainty
map.重复性同人同具，再现性跨人/设备。: Repeatability is same person and same gauge; reproducibility is across people/equipment.
map.EV% 应远小于公差或过程变异。: EV% should be far smaller than the tolerance or process variation.
